body: 设计一张竖版教育信息图，解释一台虚构家用浓缩咖啡机如何工作。以清楚的剖面结构展示水箱、泵、加热单元、冲煮头、粉饼和接液杯，用连续箭头区分冷水、热水和咖啡流向。每个部件只标一个简短中文名称。顶部标题为“从水到咖啡”，底部用三句话说明过程，网格整齐，白底，蓝色与咖啡棕配色。

en.title: Coffee machine process infographic
en.description: Cutaway espresso machine shows water tank, pump, heater, brew head, coffee puck and cup
en.body:
## How to use

Use the exact recorded prompt. No reference image is required. Changes to the prompt or inputs create an untested variant.

## Observed result

Cutaway espresso machine shows water tank, pump, heater, brew head, coffee puck and cup. Chinese labels and three explanatory steps are legible; schematic layout is illustrative, not an engineering drawing.

## Source and generation

The source provides an original prompt; this production uses the separately recorded working prompt. [Source](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/image-prompting#explain-a-process-visually). Source-post engagement does not measure this newly generated example.

Produced with the built-in GPT Image tool. The tool did not return an exact provider model ID; GPT Image 2.6 is the research topic, not a verified version claim for this output. All reference images used here were generated for this project.
